scope: operator validation of a guided starting point; not autonomous campaign evidence
audit_notes: The flux-derivative rate is smoother than the local electric-field estimator at 16 particles per cell per population.
The late flux-derivative values are compatible with the established order-0.1 collisionless rate, but this one point does not prove a plateau or universality boundary.
The current openPMD record is named lowercase j by this runtime; the reader uses that observed schema.
The CUDA runtime lacks Pillow, so the program writes a dependency-free SVG diagnostic figure.
The raw 78 MB operator run is retained beside this package but is deliberately not injected into the autonomous workspace.
Fresh prospective campaign execution remains mandatory before any supplied program output can support a claim.
